hazards.note: Far-side seats remain more angled and can have more restricted views of entrances and exits.

sections.name: Front Center Mezzanine

hazards.note: Less legroom than the Orchestra.

sections.name: Side Mezzanine
sections.rationale: The very sides are not obstructed and can offer strong value. Expect a more angled view from side and back seats.

hazards.note: Side and back seats have a more angled view of the stage.

sections.name: Balcony
